content.title: Bas Mazagran Residential Development — 238 Homes
summary: Located in Bas Mazagran, Mostaganem, this residential development comprises seven structural blocks delivering 200 social housing units and 38 market-rate apartments, alongside ground-floor commercial premises.
The project optimises vertical density across five to nine storey blocks, with dedicated pedestrian access and integrated site roads and services.
description: The 238 apartments are distributed across seven reinforced concrete blocks, with four apartments per landing to maximise internal circulation efficiency. Block heights range from R+5 to R+9.
Construction is advancing through the final trades phase, with secondary architectural works, facade masonry infill, building services installations, and site roads and utility networks underway.

faq.question: What does the Bas Mazagran development include?
faq.answer: The project delivers 200 social housing units and 38 market-rate apartments across seven structural blocks, with ground-floor commercial premises integrated throughout.

faq.question: What is the structural configuration of the blocks?
faq.answer: Seven reinforced concrete blocks range from R+5 to R+9 in height, each with four apartments per landing, providing a total of 238 residential units.

faq.question: Who is the client for this development?
faq.answer: The project is being delivered for the Office de Promotion et de Gestion Immobilière (OPGI) to address regional housing requirements in Mostaganem.

faq.question: What is the current construction status?
faq.answer: The project is currently in its final trades phase, with facade masonry, building services installations, and site roads and infrastructure works in progress.
